headline: The family-standard Help menu
highlights: The Help menu is now the KL's Tools family standard — Send Diagnostics to KL, Ask KL for a Feature, and What's New in this version (⇧⌘/), and nothing else. The system's default Help items led nowhere in this app, so they are gone.
Ask KL for a Feature — describe what's missing, read exactly what will be sent, and it reaches KL directly. Nothing sends without your click.
